headline.text: Where Senate Republicans stand on counting the electoral college vote

items.text: While a challenge to the electoral college result from some Republicans is not expected to prevail — Democrats control the House and almost every Senate Republican would need to join the effort for their chamber to approve it — it will force a debate, drawing out a process that is usually a formality and forcing lawmakers to choose between honoring the choice of voters or standing with Trump.
